units.headline: Record lookup failures no longer fail loadMetadata; error discarded
units.summary: loadMetadata used to return getRecord's error. Now it ignores every error and returns a Metadata holding whatever partial record getRecord built, with Owner left empty. Callers can no longer tell a failed lookup from a record that has no owner.
focus: Every error is discarded, including transient connection or timeout errors, not only FORBIDDEN replies
Callers that relied on the error to retry or to skip the item
Code that reads md.record.Owner and treats an empty owner as meaningful

issues.title: Transient lookup errors silently produce ownerless records
issues.failure_scenario: The inventory server is briefly unreachable, so fetchFromServer returns a connect error. The item is tracked with Owner == "", and the client caches that error for 5 minutes, so no caller retries and nothing reports the failure.

units.reason: Changes error propagation, so items can now be tracked with incomplete ownership data.

units.headline: New tests for the client's error/success caching and the loader fallback
units.summary: Adds tests for the failure cache's TTL and per-key behaviour, the success cache, isErrorReply unwrapping, and the loadMetadata fallback. The file is test-only and adds no production behaviour.
units.reason: New test file only; it cannot affect production behaviour.
